[[File:DroidSpa-EP.png|thumb|The Droid Spa on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]]]
A '''spa''' was a place where one could go to get some rest and relaxation.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Droid Spa/Legends|droid spa]] was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. There was a [[day spa]] at the [[Sanads of Rorkee]] hotel on [[Genarius]].
